description: This file defines an abstract class 'Message' implementing the PSR-7 MessageInterface, providing common functionality for HTTP messages such as headers, protocol version, and body management in the Slim Framework.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the PSR-7 MessageInterface, providing methods to manage HTTP message components such as protocol version, headers, and body in the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP protocol version used in the message.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version, validating against allowed versions.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the header values for a given header name.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Concatenates header values into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header set to a value.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an additional header value appended.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified stream as the body.
